description:
Open the browser-confirmation handshake to loosen a Lane 2 wallet's
permission mode.

Call this when set_permission_mode refuses with
BROWSER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. Does NOT change the mode -- returns a
confirmation URL like request_wallet_policy_loosening; the wallet's OWNER
must approve in their own browser (never in-chat). Poll with
poll_permission_mode_change(device_code) once approved. Refused upfront
for a change that needs no confirmation (invalid mode, non-Lane-2 wallet,
or a tightening -- call set_permission_mode directly for those).
name: request_permission_mode_change
